name: jira-issue-comment
script:
set -e
id=${PECORE_PARAMS_TICKET:-$PECORE_TICKET_ID}
case "$id" in "https://$PECORE_JIRA_SITE/browse/"*) id=${id##*/} ;; esac
case "$id" in ""|-*|*[!a-zA-Z0-9-]*) echo "Enter a valid Jira ticket ID or link." >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
input=$(cat)
body=${PECORE_PARAMS_COMMENT:-}
if [ -z "$body" ]; then
  body=$(printf '%s\n' "$input" | jq -er '.text // .reference.url | strings | select(length > 0)')
fi
is_delivery=$(printf '%s\n' "$input" | jq -r '.text == null and .reference.url != null')
acli jira workitem comment create --key "$id" --body="$body"
